journey.name: profile cleanup failure
journey.description: Requires a disposable test identity with saved contacts and a controlled homeserver proxy. Never use a personal profile. Inject a private-endpoint withdrawal failure, then in a fresh fixture inject an unknown contact-removal response or a partial removal acknowledging only some contacts. Separately prepare an active recurring subscription in each role (payer and payee), with an unrelated saved contact, and record endpoint/contact state before confirming removal. Verify the subscription warning appears before cleanup; cancel or expire the subscription in the disposable fixture and confirm removal again to verify it can proceed. Also inject a profile-deletion error whose message contains 404 Not Found, without confirming deletion. These controls are not available in standard staging. This journey covers stopping on incomplete cleanup, not cross-device conditional deletion or safe manual replay of an uncertain operation.

actions.action: With an active subscription, confirm profile deletion or unlink and verify the localized instruction to end active subscriptions
Verify there is no generic Retry dialog, endpoint withdrawal, contact removal or profile deletion, including for the unrelated contact
After ending the subscription, explicitly confirm removal again and verify acknowledged cleanup succeeds
Open Edit Profile and confirm deletion with the cleanup fault enabled
Verify failure options appear without a success notification or onboarding navigation
Verify a failed private withdrawal is followed by no contact or profile deletion
Verify unknown contact removal keeps local contact data and prevents profile deletion
Verify partial contact removal preserves contacts and overrides not acknowledged as removed
Verify an uncertain profile-deletion error preserves the session and sharing settings without success feedback
Cancel the failure dialog and verify the app starts no second deletion
Restart the app and verify no profile deletion is automatically replayed
